description: Formal AgentMemBench/MESA baseline: the pinned upstream harness's own phase functions at upstream defaults (seed 2027, MemDialogue v2 9,170 records) with Agent Memory behind the upstream five-method adapter through the public facade; M2 judged recall deferred to a frozen Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct judge and blocked pending an authorized credential; M6 not comparable.

benchmark.name: AgentMemBench / MESA formal protocol (MemDialogue v2, seed 2027)

source_rights.attribution: MemDialogue is derived from WildChat-4.8M by the Allen Institute for AI; harness semantics follow agentmembench/evaluation/unified_benchmark.py (sha256 d0d407129aa506f6eacbf6df19a26c1a9ddd000aa0bfb931cb4e4ae984e594df)
source_rights.acquisition_notes: Operators obtain data/memdialogue_v2.jsonl from the pinned upstream revision; the runner hashes the raw file and records whether it matches the upstream release digest.

selection.identity_rule: input.selection.source_ids_sha256 = sha256 of newline-joined selected source ids
methods: upstream load_records: source-unique, event-type-stratified, numpy default_rng(seed)

native_metrics.description: M2 retrieval, LLM-judged by the upstream judge; blocked until an authorized frozen judge is provisioned
M2 deterministic diagnostics (adapted), computed identically for the five published upstream files
M4 conflict phase, top-1, plus per-case stage classification (adapted/diagnostic attribution)

native_artifacts.description: unified-benchmark-v2 shaped report plus agent_memory evidence block (linked-only retrieval details)

budget.retrieval_or_context_budget: top-k 5 at upstream defaults; phase sizes per upstream defaults

failure_semantics.description: the runner refuses to execute unless upstream, runner, arguments and the Agent Memory runtime binding all match the freeze; judged recall is emitted only when every non-empty row receives a parsed verdict, otherwise blocked

native_protocol.concurrency: sequential phases; the concurrency phase uses ThreadPoolExecutor at the declared worker counts

system_requirements.unsupported_semantics: a backend without deletion or isolation semantics is scored by the native protocol for those phases; the Agent Memory arm reports governed tombstone deletion rather than physical deletion

judge.note: execution needs no judge; the judged M2 metric needs one authorized judge per decision-eval-credential

mappings.semantics: adapted diagnostic; lower bound on judged recall
raw dataset digest verified equal to the pinned upstream release before execution

unmapped_dimensions.reasoning: not_measured: no answer generation; M6 LLM portability is not comparable because upstream ships no executable protocol
unmapped_dimensions.evaluator_integrity: not_measured in this run: the formal profile reuses the upstream evaluator unchanged; mutation probes for the adapted profile run separately (#518)

negative_controls.description: adapter returns stale write first; staleness_rate must rise
adapter leaks across users; cross_user_leak_rate must rise
adapter ignores delete; post-delete absence must fall
adapter drops writes; recall must fall
adapter corrupts source identity mapping; exact-source recall must fall

evaluator_integrity.qualification_expectation: all_detected must be true; retrieval and concurrency phases are declared not_probed

seed.note: numpy default_rng(seed) drives stratified sampling and bootstrap CIs

environment_requirements: no network access required once the dataset is present
reproducibility.revision_binding: freeze: upstream revision + harness/dataset/meta/results-manifest sha256 + runner sha256 + Agent Memory runtime tree + ranking policy + contract + package pins; report: agent_memory.freeze + agent_memory_verification

gauntlet.reason: the upstream five-method adapter protocol (reset/add/search/delete/close) maps onto reset/remember/recall/forget operation envelopes; a Gauntlet profile binding is deferred until a system-neutral runner exists for the same-harness comparator work (#640)

evidence_history.blocker: no explicitly authorized, version-pinned Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct judge endpoint is provisioned (decision-eval-credential)

product_findings.summary: formal M4 new-fact 0.20 / staleness 0.80: write-time state_change_candidate detected in 250/250 pairs but never reaches read-path currentness; BM25 decides every pair
M2 diagnostics trail verbatim dense retrieval (answer-substring 0.728 vs Naive RAG 0.794): semantic vector route unreachable through the facade

limitations: M2 LLM-judged recall blocked pending an authorized judge
comparator values are published reference under the identical protocol, not reproduced here
